intro.text: A washwoman who works for Mraize in Vedenar.

items.text: Skilled with dyes, fabrics and cleaners, Mem washed clothes with other washwomen in Vedenar. She removed a stubborn stain, which she took for oil and blood, from Mraize's Azish cavalrylord's suit, earning a three-firemark bonus and his praise.
She briefly had a surprisingly beautiful assistant named Pom, and was flabbergasted when Pom destroyed one of Mraize's paintings.

personality.text: She likes Mraize's refined manners and taste in clothes, thinks servants are watched more closely than people believe, and finds her work fulfilling, since clean clothes will always be needed.
